response.courseDescription: 105 Navigating Business Careers Establish and clarify major/career goals through career assessments and research on job expectations, employment trends, and essential skills; develop actionable goals and plans to enhance career success; focus on professional development, including the hiring process, resume/cover letter writing, interview strategies, networking, and online branding. Credit not granted for HBM 105 if credit is already earned in both of B A 102 and HBM 101.
response.coursePrerequisites: B A 100 or concurrent enrollment or admitted to a major or minor in the College of Business. Enrollment not allowed if credit already earned in both B A 102 and HBM 101.
